name: Nightmare Vale
summary: Twisted trees and hungry beasts crowd Nightmare Vale in southwestern Tirisfal Glades, west of the Crusader's Outpost. Once a forest haven, it now lies blighted and withered.

sections.title: A Decayed Wilderness
sections.body: Before the Third War, songbirds and woodland game filled this valley in the Tirisfal countryside. After the Scourge's plague, its plants blackened and rotted. Ravenous darkhounds and massive vampire bats consumed the native wildlife, leaving the hollow to scavengers and beasts of prey.

sections.title: Stalkers of the Hollow
sections.body: Ressan the Needler, an unusually large, pale vampire bat, lurks in Nightmare Vale and is known to local travelers. The vale lies between haunted wilderness and the zealous sentries at the nearby Crusader's Outpost. Unwary travelers crossing this unforgiving expanse can quickly become prey.

faq.answer: Nightmare Vale lies in southwestern Tirisfal Glades, just west of the Crusader's Outpost.

faq.q: Why is the valley called Nightmare Vale?
faq.answer: The plague that devastated Lordaeron consumed what had been a peaceful, vibrant forest. Withered trees and aggressive predators, including hungry darkhounds and blood-drinking bats, make the valley a waking nightmare for travelers.
Savage darkhounds and giant vampire bats roam the vale, driving out or consuming native forest animals. The rare white vampire bat Ressan the Needler also prowls there.
Ressan the Needler is a rare, stark-white vampire bat that stalks Nightmare Vale's dark skies and withered canopy.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see the plague's lingering mark across Tirisfal in Nightmare Vale's twisted wildlife. Those beasts threaten travelers who venture beyond Brill.
As a hunter, you can find vicious darkhounds and vampire bats in the vale, including the rare white bat Ressan the Needler. These fearsome beasts make the vale a notable hunting ground.
